mockup_description.layout: Header shows class/subject/time. Three quick-action buttons row. KPI strip. Per-student rows.
key_elements: KPI strip: total students, exceptions-to-verify count, approved-excuse count (variant A) OR Présents/Retard/Absent/Excusé counts (variant B)
Per-student row: avatar/initials, name, real attendance-rate %, 4-way status selector (Présent/Retard/Absent/Excusé)
Selected row expands (variant A) showing a low-attendance-rate warning card: 'Taux de présence faible < 80% -- N absences ce mois-ci' + 'Voir l'historique' link
When status = Retard: inline 'Retard (minutes)' numeric input appears (variant B) -- matches what was just built
Bulk-select checkboxes per row (variant C) for group actions
'Note de l'enseignant' free-text field (variant B, page-level not per-student)
Persistent 'Brouillon enregistré / Dernière sauvegarde à HH:MM' or 'Brouillon Non enregistré' status indicator
Sticky bottom 'Enregistrer la présence' / 'Soumettre la présence (N élèves)' button
interactions: Tap a status pill to set that student's status
Auto-save draft periodically (implied by the 'Dernière sauvegarde' timestamp) before final submit
Expandable per-student detail card for at-risk students with a deep-link to their history

what_matches: Tout Présent / Tout Absent quick actions -- real
Real per-student attendance-rate badge, real low-attendance warning badge (<80%)
Per-student note input -- real (page has per-student notes, mockup variant B has one page-level note -- current app's per-student granularity is arguably better)
Inline 'Retard (minutes)' input on status=late -- just built this session, matches mockup 3 closely
Sticky submit button ('Enregistrer la présence') -- real
what_differs: No auto-save draft / 'Brouillon enregistré' persistence -- explicitly scoped as optional in ATTENDANCE-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md Section 7.2 and skipped this session
No expandable low-attendance warning card with 'Voir l'historique' deep-link -- current app shows only a compact badge, no expand-on-tap detail
No bulk-select checkboxes for group status changes (beyond the existing Tout Présent/Tout Absent which already covers the main bulk use case)
No 'exceptions à vérifier' summary count in the KPI strip
